messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a runtime config change + small DB migration tonight during the 02:00 UTC quiet window. Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Need quick ACKs and owners for smoke and rollback.
alex: ack. I can own the smoke checklist and quick rollback. Will run canary smoke on staging first then prod canary run.
tim: thx. SRE/monitoring note: I added an alert threshold for p95 latency + token error spikes. Also will take a DB snapshot just before cutover.
jess: who is toggling the feature flag? Need an explicit step in runbook and an estimated duration for the migration.
maria: alex will toggle flags. Migration is small (index add + backfill on a shard) — expected ~6m, but we'll have a safety window of 20m.
alex: plan:
- pre: run quick schema check on canary shard
- deploy: 02:00 UTC start, 5% for 5m
- validate: smoke endpoints, latency, error rates
- escalate -> 25% for 10m if green
- full -> 100% after final signoff
jess: please add the exact curl checks for smoke so I can sanity-check the API contract.
alex: smoke commands (run from deploy box):

```
# health
curl -sS https://api.internal/v1/health | jq .status
# sample inference
curl -sS -X POST https://api.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .choices[0]
```

tim: I'll run perf/latency check and KV cache validation post-step. If p95 > 400ms or error rate > 0.5% revert immediately.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by maria for 2026-04-02 02:00:00 UTC — 5% canary first. Refer: #deploy-runbook-382
maria: pre-deploy checklist (quick):
- [x] PRs merged and CI green
- [x] DB migration script reviewed
- [x] Monitoring alerts added
- [ ] DB snapshot taken (tim)
- [ ] Smoke runbook posted to ops channel (alex)
- [ ] Rollback tested on staging (alex)
alex: taking smoke runbook now and will post in ops channel. Will confirm rollback test result by 01:30 UTC.
tim: doing DB snapshot at 01:45 UTC and will paste snapshot id here when done.
jess: +1 on runbook steps. If anyone sees unexpected inference degradations, please tag me and SRE immediately. :eyes:
maria: final signoffs — please reply with a single-word ACK when you’re set.
alex: ACK
tim: ACK
jess: ACK
maria: thanks — starting quiet prep. If anything blocks before 01:50 UTC, call it out here and we’ll abort the window.
